item.title: Court temporarily blocks Warner Bros./Paramount Merger at Attorney General Ellison’s request
item.description:
Publication Date: July 20, 2026

Court’s temporary restraining order halts the merger while the court considers a preliminary injunction, which would block the merger for the duration of the lawsuit that AG Ellison filed on July 13
